readingMode: Full sequential direct native reading completed before registration; original cover and seven substantive original pages visually inspected, cross-page provisions reopened. No annex beyond page 29.

coverage.authoredAnalysis: Original cover visually read: Aragón Existe, general elections 2023. Native cover contains only page number. No policy inferred from cover.
Aragón-wide introduction expressly addresses Congress and Senate; complete fourteen-topic index. This programme is distinct from the retained Teruel document.

Explicit next 23 July, Cortes Generales and Aragón Existe vote request. Parliamentary achievements, causal claims and useful-vote rhetoric are source assertions, not independently verified facts. Canfranc named in introduction.

Introduction continues with public services, housing, energy, rural inequality and direct request for Aragón Existe Congress/Senate candidates. Cross-page introduction completed; no separate adopted programme for Teruel inferred.

Territorial budgets, democratic dialogue, education and disinformation study commission. State minimum welfare-service funding considers dispersion and density; regional improvements separately financed. Progressive taxation and anti-fraud resources omit exact rates.

Local financing below 2,000 inhabitants and direct provincial/comarcal representatives. Aragón autonomy, historical debt and low-density business aid; no national constituency or judicial appointment rule.

Climate 2030/2050, vulnerable energy consumers, local energy communities and storage. Home efficiency target 700,000 per year, 30% rural, completes on this page; differs from Teruel pagination. Criticism of deployment is not opposition to all renewables.

Moratorium on large renewable parks and very-high-voltage lines for planning. Local compensation/canon; 20% of grid-node access for small installations. Distributed generation, self-consumption, communities and climate-law/substation reform.

Nudo Mudéjar/Andorra industrial and rail projects, environmental assessment/resources/circular economy/protected spaces. Landscape paragraph continues; source assertions on impacts are not independent proof.

Completes landscape policy; forestry/stewardship/extensive livestock. Water framework, rejection of Ebro transfer, adequate supply and drought measures. No ownership rule for drinking-water management.

Aragón water pact/ecological flows/sustainable reservoirs; Lechago/riverbanks/irrigation renewables. Unlike Teruel PDF, no Guadalope/Andorra water lifting details. Rural State pact and qualified housing-tax relief begin.

Completes rural housing-tax relief: towns below 5,000 in depopulated areas, low/middle incomes, possible IBI exemption and 80% property-transfer reduction; State replaces local forgone IBI. 100/30/30: connectivity, services within 30 minutes, transport access within 30 km. Financial-access paragraph continues.

Completes financial access/ATMs. Public offices/Correos and rural public-worker supplement; rehabilitation-linked rentals/protected housing, participation/women/employment/telework. No all-procedure nondigital guarantee or general rent cap.

Business aid maximum in Teruel/authorized contiguous Belchite/Daroca/Aranda; seek EU extension to other low-density Huesca/Zaragoza counties. No claim every county already authorized. Public/universal health pact, primary care 25% of healthcare budget and management training. 90% problem-resolution is a programme assertion.

Electronic records/waiting lists/cancer screening/staff/MIR. National portfolio expressly includes dental and mental health; urgent-transport paragraph continues on page 16. Inclusion does not define dental treatment basket, psychotherapy, copayment abolition or a pharmaceutical company.

Completes internalized sustainable urgent transport. Public health indicators, social/dependency/equality, education and older-person home/neighbourhood care begin; no school-meal promise inferred from older-person services.

Completes older-person meals/care. Public/protected/rural rental housing; telework/shared care, general surrogacy rejection, rural women and natality paragraph starts. No foreign-registration, child-right or penal policy inferred.

Completes natality: lactation until one year with accumulated hours, flexible care and nursery 0-3. Neither six-month maternity/paternity leave nor universal free nursery established. Gender/LGTBI equality and rural-demographic narrative begin.

Rural custody/extensive livestock and rural-impact assessment. Professional agriculture/fair prices, family-agriculture law and preference over macrofarms. No ban on hunting, companion-animal sales, fur breeding, force-feeding or glyphosate established.

Agricultural science/biosecurity; CAP based on current production rather than historical data. Year-round fire prevention, rural Civil Guard and law 45/2007 update; no nuclear weapons treaty or defence expenditure share.
Heritage/resources/Montes de Socios legal reform. Road-mesh chapter and Huesca A-21/A-22/A-23 begin; no road-versus-rail exclusion inferred.
Pyrenean N-230/N-260/N-330, AP-2 access, N-122/N-121c and Borja/Tarazona. Mediterranean interior/Aragón/Teruel highways/bypasses. Conventional railway paragraph starts.

Completes conventional railway/AVE integration, Zaragoza-Teruel-Sagunto and Platea/Andorra branches. Canfranc international tunnel/standard gauge/Zaragoza-Pau. Rural public mobility begins; no domestic flight limitation.

Completes mobility; on-demand transport without reduced fare or reference municipality. Separate Huesca/Zaragoza rail routes/frequencies plus Teruel-Madrid; buses. Broadband paragraph begins; preserve cross-page context.

Completes broadband: fibre nodes below 20 km, minimum 100 Mbps symmetric, 5G/digital training/accessible e-administration. Claimed rural gap and legal duties are source assertions. Science begins; access is not universal free Internet.
Science evidence/talent aid, territorial degrees/research and culture. No open-research-results mandate, repeating-course tuition rule or quantified science budget.
Tourism/geoparks and specific Aragón science institutes/Dinópolis; rural industry/local processing begins. No national party-policy or universal outcome inferred from named local projects.

Completes industrial/logistics dispersal. Business-aid broader low-density scope repeated; earlier authorization/extension distinction retained. Rural self-employed aid/shared premises/employment/social economy; towns below 200 shops/bars classification. No first-year or low-income contribution exemption.

Tourism/LEADER, Zaragoza free zone with airport access controls and Calatayud logistics, Aranda footwear modernization and Aragón local food. Unlike Teruel PDF, no FITE 90-million target. Final lower whitespace; no further annex or footnotes.
